observations: Photo shows an open fabric wardrobe/closet with multiple hanging compartments (grid shelves) and hanging rail sections.
Frame appears to be wood or wood-like material with fabric panels/covering; no clear brand label visible.
Some items are stored inside the wardrobe in the photo, making it hard to inspect the interior fabric condition closely.
Overall looks used but intact; no obvious large tears or stains are clearly visible from this single image.

identity.kind: open wardrobe (fabric/portable closet with shelves and hanging space)

claims.claim: It a open wardrobe, can be used at home or boutique
claims.evidence: Supported only in general by the item type shown in photo 0; intended use (home vs boutique) is not verifiable remotely.
No receipt/date proof visible in photo 0.
Photo 0 does not show a close-up of fabric panels; small stains/tears could be hidden by stored items.
Photo 0 does not clearly show foam components (e.g., padding) to assess firmness.
No odor/smoke exposure evidence visible in photo 0.

risks.risk: Hidden stains/tears on fabric panels or seams not visible because the wardrobe is packed in the photo.
risks.proof: Request 2–3 close-up photos of each fabric panel/seam (front, sides, and inside corners) with items removed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible minor fabric wear (worst case: stains/tears present).

risks.risk: Missing/loose parts (zippers, connectors, poles, shelf ties) or weak frame joints.
risks.proof: Request a short video showing the wardrobe being assembled/standing stable, plus close-ups of all joints/connectors.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing repair/parts if any are missing (worst case: not fully functional).

risks.risk: Odor (smoke, dampness) that isn’t detectable from the single photo.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo/video of the wardrobe being aired out and a confirmation of no damp smell; ideally request a quick smell/odor check video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if odor may be present (worst case: requires cleaning/airing).

risks.risk: Foam firmness claim may refer to padding that isn’t visible; could be sagging or damaged.
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of any foam/padded sections (if any) and a hand-press video to show rebound.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if foam is not firm/unknown condition (worst case: foam worn).

proof_requests: Send close-up photos of all fabric panels and seams (front, sides, inside corners) with items removed.
Send a short video showing the wardrobe standing and stable, including all joints/connectors.
Show any foam/padded parts clearly (if present) with a hand-press/rebound clip.
Provide proof of purchase date (receipt or message) if claiming 'bought new last year'.
response.reason: The item type is clear from photo 0 (open wardrobe with shelves/hanging space), but key condition claims (no stains/tears, foam firmness, smoke-free) are not verifiable from a single packed photo. Missing decisive condition proof prevents confident worst-case pricing.
